comments.author: Steward
comments.body:
@Carla Ignorant comment is ignorant. This skill is perfect when the player uses cannons. You wouldn't need penetration. This skill is especially perfect for grinding, and it's also a plus that cannons are cheaper than Carronades and have better penetration power. When your gunnery is Maxxed rank, you can ditch this.

Ballistics + Accuracy + Reloading is as lethal, if not more, that Balls/Acc/Penet if you know what to use and know what you're doing.

comments.author: Enver
comments.body: The posts above are outdated so not replying for the posters but just laying some facts down for all to see in future. First, using cannon14 or cannon16 does not mean you should ditch penetration and replace it with reload, as penetration helps you one shot with criticals and even outside of critical normal shots that deal loads of damage reduces opponent's max dura. Second, most serious PvP'ers do not just randomly/rapidly fire their cannons whenever they're loaded but instead aim for criticals so reloading quicker does not help much. Personally I use this only when I use ships with armour deteriortion bullet or smoke screen and spread the condition to enemy fleet, or when we are singling out an enemy like 3v1 where enemy's allies are far away (it happens, don't ask me why lol) so we are repeatly firing combos and killing even if it's just broadside shots.
